name: llm-checker
description: Work out which local LLM this machine can run, from measured hardware and a real memory budget.

pick-model.description: Recommend a local model that fits this machine's VRAM

runtime-check.description: Show this machine's hardware budget and installed Ollama models

interface.shortDescription: Find which local models this machine can actually run.
interface.longDescription: Reads the real GPU, unified or dedicated memory budget and installed Ollama models with the llm-checker CLI, then ranks local models by what fits this hardware. The ranking is a fit and suitability score, not a public benchmark result, and the skill requires presenting it that way. It never downloads a model, starts a server, or changes runtime configuration.
defaultPrompt: Which local model can my machine run?
What should I run for coding on this GPU?
Will a 14B model fit in my memory budget?
What are my hardware limits for local models?
